dedupe_keys.name: smotec smart mobility on the edge computing

description: SMOTEC is an implemented testbed for adaptive smart-mobility experiments with edge computing. The authors describe Docker integration of SUMO urban-mobility simulation, Raspberry Pi devices communicating through ZeroMQ, EPOS decentralized load balancing and K3s orchestration. These components support prototyping and optimizing placement of intelligence services across edge-to-cloud resources. A proof-of-concept uses traffic monitoring from Munich. The inspected abstract supplies the concrete infrastructure role, without verifying the claimed cost advantage or performance outside that experiment. The public TDI-Lab repository identifies Java and GPL-3.0 source licensing. The Zenodo virtual-appliance package separately declares CC BY 4.0, so that declaration does not replace the source-code licence or establish rights for every bundled dependency. Native package publication is dated February 2023 and the inspected preprint July 2023; these dates are preserved without inferring software creation history. Geographic coverage of the related testbed is not restricted to the named proof-of-concept by the metadata. No appliance, code, README, installation instructions or media was downloaded or executed.
